annotations.title: Vedic and Western signs side by side

description: Use this when someone asks what their sign is in Vedic (sidereal) astrology compared with Western (tropical) astrology, why their sign is different in Vedic astrology, or for their "real" or sidereal zodiac sign ("I am a Leo, what am I in Vedic astrology", "my sidereal sun sign", "why does my Vedic chart show different signs"). Returns the Sun, the Moon and every planet counted both ways, the gap between the two zodiacs (the ayanamsa), and with a birth time the rising sign both ways. Works from the birth date and town.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).
